comment: Pinned upstream of Ubuntu's own FFmpeg (the system libavcodec that mpv/Haruna, VLC, Qt Multimedia and thumbnailers use), rebuilt with this project's hardware decoders registered ahead of the software ones (docs/108). Distinct from packages/ffmpeg, the private FFmpeg of rungic-codec for Firefox. packages/ffmpeg-ubuntu/debian replaces its debian/ (Ubuntu's packaging plus our patches under debian/patches/rungic); the shared codec client and adapter are placed into libavcodec by the overlay, so libavcodec carries them itself and depends on nothing of ours. Built without the extra flavour (pkg.ffmpeg.noextra): the phone has the standard libraries.
